title: Filter chats and clear your unread
blurb: Find the messages that need you, then mark them read, starred or done.

steps.title: See what's unread
steps.body: Unread chats are in bold and the counter shows how many are waiting. Opening a chat does not mark it read. It stays unread until you reply or mark it read, so nothing slips through.

steps.title: Open filters
steps.body: Click the filter icon above the chat list. Add a rule such as **Filter By Assigned** is me, or **Filter By Tag** is hot-lead. The list updates straight away.

steps.title: Change the order
steps.body: Use the sort option to show oldest first, so the people who've waited longest are at the top.

steps.title: Select several chats
steps.body: Tick the boxes next to the chats you want to tidy up. A toolbar appears at the top of the list.

steps.title: Mark them read or starred
steps.body: Click **Mark as Read** to clear them, or **Add Star** to flag ones to come back to.
